scope: Explicit reviewed 70-ID release; no other dataset approval

eurostat.scope: Only DE/FR/IT and exact EA21 macro data; exclude third-country and restricted detailed trade. Source/access date and Eurostat non-responsibility notice retained.

ons.basis: OGL v3; original ONS statistical tables, no licensed images or other excluded material

ons.scope: Original ONS CDID statistics and own construction workbook columns under OGL v3; no licensed images or third-party content.

bea.basis: Original BEA NIPA tables, public domain; no third-party content selected
bea.scope: Original NIPA GDP level, real disposable income, savings and investment. Chained dollars and annual-rate definitions retained.

census.basis: Original Census C30, Survey of Construction and M3 statistical tables are federal works; not a licence inference from mere API availability
census.scope: Original C30 and M3 numerical statistics authored by the federal agency; no third-party materials. 17 USC 105 and Census DS027 provide evidence.

boe.basis: IADB data reuse under OGL v3; selected own monetary statistics and rates, not excluded LSEG exchange rates or Crown-dependency material. SONIA-specific attribution retained.

boe.scope: Own Bank Rate and house-purchase approval counts only; exclude licensed FX and Crown-dependency sources. No new SONIA selection.

ecb.scope: Own ECB deposit-facility rate and M3; no third-party FX. Original values/metadata retained; derived views labelled MacroLens.

eia.basis: EIA-authored statistics in these identified historical files; no separately protected third-party material selected
eia.scope: Existing three public physical series only; no new EIA display grant. Initial dated acknowledgment retained; source-check/file-modified dates are not publication dates.
